description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order Published in Gaz.Ex.Ord No. 1454/37 of 22.07.2006 which Specifies the Faculties & Departments of the University of Kelaniya by adding the item "17. Department of Medical Education"
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. The Minister is exercising powers vested by statute to amend the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Kelaniya. While it mentions a minister by name, this is incidental to the core legal/regulatory function of amending existing legislation and university governance structures, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
